scripts.build: npm run build-common && npm run build-dd && npm run build-audit && npm run build-swaggerui && npm run build-redoc
scripts.build-dd: cd data-dictionary && npm run build && cd .. && mkdirp dist/data-dictionary && cpy --flat data-dictionary/dist/* dist/data-dictionary
scripts.build-audit: cd audit && npm run build && cd .. && mkdirp dist/audit && cpy --flat audit/dist/* dist/audit
scripts.build-swaggerui: cd preview-swaggerui && npm run build && cd .. && mkdirp dist/preview/swaggerui && cpy --flat preview-swaggerui/dist/* dist/preview/swaggerui
scripts.build-redoc: cd preview-redoc && npm run build && cd .. && mkdirp dist/preview/redoc && cpy --flat preview-redoc/dist/* dist/preview/redoc
